discoveries.choice: notes.txt contains exactly one short line of plain text, "one line of notes", with no extra structure (no headings, keys, timestamps, or metadata).
discoveries.whyItMatters: The phase's goal is a minimal notes file; keeping the content a single unstructured line means downstream consumers can treat the file as opaque prose rather than a parseable format. Any assumption of structure would be unsupported by the artifact.

alternatives.option: Write notes with added structure such as a dated heading or key/value metadata (e.g. "# Notes\ndate: ...").
alternatives.consequence: Consumers might attempt to parse the file, so the format would become an implicit contract that later edits must honor, increasing coupling and breakage risk.

alternatives.option: Write a longer multi-line body of notes.
alternatives.consequence: More surface area to review and maintain, and the file would no longer be trivially verifiable as "one line of notes".

recommendation.choice: Keep notes.txt as a single unstructured line of plain text.
recommendation.reason: It is the minimal artifact that satisfies the stated purpose, keeping the format unconstrained and easy to review or replace.

discoveries.choice: Text is written as plain sentence case prose without any trailing content (no trailing newline/blank line beyond the single line).
discoveries.whyItMatters: Whether the file ends with a newline affects byte-level diffs and checksum-based verification; consumers diffing or hashing the file need to know that the content is exactly the single line and nothing more.

alternatives.option: Append a trailing newline after the line.
alternatives.consequence: The file's hash and diff representation change, which matters if any verification is hash-based, though POSIX text-file conventions favor a trailing newline.

recommendation.choice: Accept the file as-is with the single line of text and no additional content.
recommendation.reason: The artifact already matches the stated intent; adding bytes would only shift hashes without adding meaning.
